home.title: Secret ballots, results you can trust
home.lead: Vote-Kidigit runs elections for your SACCO, association, school or church end to end, from the voter list to published results, on any phone.
home.step1Text: Add positions, contesters and voters, or upload a CSV list.
home.step2Text: Each voter receives a private code by SMS.
home.step3Text: Votes are counted when voting closes, and results are published to a link and a PDF.
home.webText: The link in the SMS opens the ballot in any browser.
home.ussdText: Any basic phone, no internet: dial a short code and follow the menu.
home.kioskText: A voting station at the venue for voters without a phone.
home.secretText: A vote is never linked to the voter who cast it.
home.auditText: Every staff action is recorded and cannot be deleted.
home.pdfText: Frozen results with a verification hash and QR code.
home.voterText: Open the link in your SMS, or start here.

mock.label: Example of the ballot on a phone: the Chairperson position, choose one contester.

features.title: Features
features.lead: Everything you need to run a secret-ballot election, from set-up to results.
features.orgText: Each organization has its own space, logo, colour and time zone.
features.staffText: Roles for moderators, observers and helpers, each with its own permissions.
features.eventsText: Scheduled opening and closing, a checklist before publishing, and locked set-up.
features.rulesText: Choose one, an exact number or a range, percentage thresholds and Yes or No votes.
features.votersText: Upload a CSV, check problems before importing, and generate private codes.
features.smsText: Send codes, reminders and results, and track the delivery of every message.
features.channelsText: Smartphone, USSD on a basic phone and a kiosk at the venue, in Swahili.
features.resultsText: A live control room, votes frozen at close, and ties resolved with a reason.
features.reportsText: A results PDF with a QR code, voter reports and a complete audit log.
features.shotCaption: The ballot as a voter sees it on a phone.
